Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Shahri Rojgar Guarantee Yojana: Urban Wage Employment Framework Explained

31 Oct 2026, 06:32 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: www.govtschemes.in

The Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Shahri Rojgar Guarantee Yojana (MSRGY) is a state-level initiative designed to support urban households in Rajasthan by providing guaranteed wage employment. Originally launched in 2022 as the Indira Gandhi Urban Employment Guarantee Scheme, the program was officially renamed via a state government order in November 2024. The scheme targets families residing within urban local body limits, offering income support through labor-based public works.

Key Scheme Features and Employment Terms

Under MSRGY, eligible families can receive up to 125 days of wage employment per year. The Rajasthan government expanded this provision from its original 100-day limit, with the revised allocation taking effect from April 1, 2023. Key operational features include:

  • Timeframe: Work must be provided within 15 days of a formal demand being submitted by a registered member.
  • Wage Structure: Daily wages align with official minimum wage rates notified by the Rajasthan Labour Department, with equal pay mandated for men and women performing identical tasks.
  • Direct Benefit Transfer: Wages are credited directly to the worker's bank account every 15 days.
  • Job Cards: A free, family-inclusive job card is issued with a five-year validity period.
  • Worksite Amenities: Basic provisions such as drinking water, first aid, summer shade, and work-information display boards are required at active sites.

Permissible projects span several urban improvement categories, including water conservation, sanitation, tree plantation, maintenance of public spaces, heritage conservation, and support labor for approved housing schemes like Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban).

Eligibility and Application Process

Residents must satisfy specific criteria to qualify for registration:

  • Geography: The family must reside within an urban local body's jurisdiction in Rajasthan.
  • Age Limits: Individual family members must be between 18 and 60 years of age to register and demand work.
  • Identification: A valid Jan Aadhaar card or Jan Aadhaar enrolment ID is mandatory. The Jan Aadhaar unit serves as the baseline family unit for the scheme.

Eligible applicants can register online via the Rajasthan Single Sign-On (SSO) portal or the dedicated MSRGY website, or offline through an authorized e-Mitra centre. Applicants without an existing Jan Aadhaar card must complete enrollment via the Jan Aadhaar portal or an e-Mitra facility before applying.

Practical Implications and Verification

For urban households experiencing economic strain or seeking localized public works, MSRGY provides a structured legal framework for temporary wage labor. However, applicants must note that holding a job card does not trigger automatic work placement; a separate work demand (Form-1) must be submitted via the portal or local authorities whenever employment is required.

What is Confirmed:

  • The scheme guarantees up to 125 days of wage employment per eligible urban family annually.
  • Registration requires a Jan Aadhaar identifier and compliance with the 18-to-60 age bracket.
  • Wage disbursements are processed directly through bank accounts on a fortnightly cycle.

What Remains Unknown:

  • Specific local project availability and exact placement timelines depend heavily on local urban body project sanctions and real-time administrative capacity within the 15-day window.

Readers and prospective applicants should verify official guidelines, current minimum wage notifications, and application portals directly through the [Official Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Shahri Rojgar Guarantee Yojana Source](https://www.govtschemes.in/rajasthan-mukhyamantri-shahri-rojgar-guarantee-yojana).
